definitions_and_cautions.categorical_diversity_score: Unofficial descriptive metric: the mean fraction outside the modal category across shape, website structure, entry type, exact symmetry class, positive-definite status, and problem kind.
definitions_and_cautions.diversity_label: Unofficial screening rule. Groups with fewer than five matrices are not classified; heterogeneous means at least three attributes have a modal share below 90%; homogeneous means none do.
definitions_and_cautions.entry_type: The website's mutually exclusive Rutherford-Boeing entry-type label: real, complex, integer, or binary. In the ssstats flags, integer and binary matrices are also real/non-complex; isBinary is a separate flag.
definitions_and_cautions.group: A provenance/source label, typically a person, organization, or earlier collection; it is not a homogeneity guarantee.
definitions_and_cautions.kind_source_discrepancy: Group statistics use the ssstats.csv kind. Four Chevron matrices are 'other problem' in ssstats.csv but '2D/3D problem' in the website repository; see kind_source_mismatches.csv.
definitions_and_cautions.nentries: All stored pattern entries, equal to nnz plus explicit zeros supplied by the matrix author.
definitions_and_cautions.nnz: Numerically nonzero entries in A; explicit stored zeros are excluded.
definitions_and_cautions.numerical_symmetry: Matched conjugate off-diagonal values divided by all off-diagonal entries; this measures Hermitian symmetry and rectangular matrices are assigned 0.
definitions_and_cautions.pattern_symmetry: Matched off-diagonal structural entries divided by all off-diagonal entries; rectangular matrices are assigned 0.
definitions_and_cautions.posdef_index: 1 known positive definite; 0 known not positive definite; -1 symmetric/Hermitian with unknown definiteness. No -1 values occur in this snapshot.
